pages.text: Today they were going to have their teeth checked. Pongi walked ahead.
"I'm not scared at all." Pongi looked up at Dad.
The white chair was very high. Grandpa Goose stood there in white clothes.
"I'll try first." Dad sat in the chair.
"Now, open your mouth, please." Dad kept his mouth tightly shut.
"Dad, you have to open your mouth." Dad shook his head.
Pongi stood beside Dad. "You do it like this."
Dad copied her and opened his mouth. Ahhh!
Pongi sat in the chair and opened wide. Ahhh! Beside her, Dad was saying ahhh too.
